workflow_id: rag_draft_response_generation
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate_agent
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "support_agent"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_receive_email
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/email/classified_thread"
    output: raw_email_thread

  - id: step_validate_email
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_email_thread
      schema: classified_email_schema
    output: validated_email

  - id: step_extract_email_body
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_email
      field: "original_email_body"
    output: email_body

  - id: step_extract_thread_history
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_email
      field: "thread_history"
    output: thread_history

  - id: step_search_support_docs
    op: call_subworkflow
    params:
      workflow_id: "search_knowledge_base"
      knowledge_base: "customerSupportDocs"
      query_context: email_body
    output: raw_support_results

  - id: step_search_club_documents
    op: call_subworkflow
    params:
      workflow_id: "search_knowledge_base"
      knowledge_base: "clubDocuments"
      query_context: email_body
    output: raw_club_results

  - id: step_search_previous_emails
    op: call_subworkflow
    params:
      workflow_id: "search_knowledge_base"
      knowledge_base: "previousEmailResponses"
      query_context: email_body
    output: raw_previous_results

  - id: step_validate_support_results
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_support_results
      schema: knowledge_base_results_schema
    output: validated_support_results

  - id: step_validate_club_results
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_club_results
      schema: knowledge_base_results_schema
    output: validated_club_results

  - id: step_validate_previous_results
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_previous_results
      schema: knowledge_base_results_schema
    output: validated_previous_results

  - id: step_merge_support_and_club
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: validated_support_results
      secondary_input: validated_club_results
      key: "topic"
    output: merged_support_club

  - id: step_merge_all_knowledge
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: merged_support_club
      secondary_input: validated_previous_results
      key: "topic"
    output: all_knowledge_results

  - id: step_detect_language
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      input: email_body
      rule: "detect_language_en_fr_es"
    output: detected_language

  - id: step_apply_season_mapping
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      input: email_body
      rule: "season_mapping_rules"
    output: season_context

  - id: step_apply_date_awareness
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      input: all_knowledge_results
      rule: "date_awareness_current_vs_past_activities"
      context: season_context
    output: date_filtered_knowledge

  - id: step_compose_draft_payload
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: date_filtered_knowledge
      mapping:
        email_body: email_body
        thread_history: thread_history
        knowledge_results: date_filtered_knowledge
        language: detected_language
        season: season_context
      template: "draft_response_prompt"
    output: draft_prompt_payload

  - id: step_generate_draft_response
    op: call_subworkflow
    params:
      workflow_id: "ai_draft_response_generator"
      input_payload: draft_prompt_payload
    output: raw_draft_response

  - id: step_validate_draft_response
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_draft_response
      schema: draft_response_schema
    output: validated_draft_response

  - id: step_filter_no_external_links
    op: filter_records
    params:
      input: validated_draft_response
      condition: "contains_only_knowledge_base_info == true AND external_links == false"
    output: safe_draft_response

  - id: step_format_gmail_draft
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: safe_draft_response
      format: "gmail_draft_json"
      language: detected_language
    output: gmail_draft_payload

  - id: step_create_gmail_draft
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: gmail_draft_payload
      url: "https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/drafts"
      method: "POST"
      action: "createDraft"
    output: draft_creation_result

  - id: step_log_draft_creation
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: gmail_draft_payload
      event: "gmail_draft_created"
      details:
        language: detected_language
        knowledge_bases_searched:
          - "customerSupportDocs"
          - "clubDocuments"
          - "previousEmailResponses"
    output: audit_log_entry

  - id: step_notify_staff
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: gmail_draft_payload
      recipient: "support_staff"
      message: "A new AI-drafted response is ready for review in Gmail Drafts."
    output: notification_result

  - id: step_handle_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      on_error: "step_create_gmail_draft"
      route_to: "step_error_terminate"

  - id: step_error_terminate
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "failure"
      reason: "Draft creation failed - manual intervention required"

  - id: step_terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "success"
      message: "Gmail draft created successfully and staff notified"

    params:
      on_error: step_create_gmail_draft
      route_to: step_error_terminate

  - id: step_error_terminate
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: failure
      reason: Draft creation failed - manual intervention required

workflow_id: rag_draft_response_generation
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate_agent
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: support_agent
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_receive_email
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: /api/email/classified_thread
    output: raw_email_thread

  - id: step_validate_email
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_email_thread
      schema: classified_email_schema
    output: validated_email

  - id: step_extract_email_body
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_email
      field: original_email_body
    output: email_body

  - id: step_extract_thread_history
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_email
      field: thread_history
    output: thread_history

  - id: step_search_customer_support_docs
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: /api/knowledge_base/customerSupportDocs/search
    output: raw_customer_support_docs_results

  - id: step_validate_customer_support_docs
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_customer_support_docs_results
      schema: knowledge_base_results_schema
    output: validated_customer_support_docs_results

  - id: step_search_club_documents
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: /api/knowledge_base/clubDocuments/search
    output: raw_club_documents_results

  - id: step_validate_club_documents
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_club_documents_results
      schema: knowledge_base_results_schema
    output: validated_club_documents_results

  - id: step_search_previous_email_responses
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: /api/knowledge_base/previousEmailResponses/search
    output: raw_previous_email_responses_results

  - id: step_validate_previous_email_responses
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_previous_email_responses_results
      schema: knowledge_base_results_schema
    output: validated_previous_email_responses_results

  - id: step_merge_support_and_club
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: validated_customer_support_docs_results
      secondary_input: validated_club_documents_results
      key: topic
    output: merged_support_and_club_results

  - id: step_merge_all_knowledge_bases
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: merged_support_and_club_results
      secondary_input: validated_previous_email_responses_results
      key: topic
    output: all_knowledge_base_results

  - id: step_detect_language
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: detect_language_en_fr_es
      input: email_body
    output: detected_language

  - id: step_apply_season_mapping
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: season_mapping_rules
      input: email_body
    output: season_context

  - id: step_apply_date_awareness
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: date_awareness_current_vs_past_activities
      input: all_knowledge_base_results
    output: date_aware_knowledge

  - id: step_compose_draft_payload
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: date_aware_knowledge
      mapping:
        email_body: email_body
        thread_history: thread_history
        knowledge_results: date_aware_knowledge
        language: detected_language
        season: season_context
      template: draft_response_prompt
    output: draft_payload

  - id: step_generate_draft_response
    op: call_subworkflow
    params:
      workflow_id: ai_draft_response_generator
      input: draft_payload
    output: raw_draft_response

  - id: step_validate_draft_response
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_draft_response
      schema: draft_response_schema
    output: validated_draft_response

  - id: step_filter_draft_response
    op: filter_records
    params:
      input: validated_draft_response
      condition: contains_only_knowledge_base_info == true AND external_links == false
    output: filtered_draft_response

  - id: step_format_gmail_draft
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: filtered_draft_response
      format: gmail_draft_json
    output: gmail_draft_payload

  - id: step_create_gmail_draft
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: gmail_draft_payload
      url: https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/drafts
      method: POST
      action: createDraft
    output: raw_draft_creation_result

  - id: step_validate_draft_creation_result
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_draft_creation_result
      schema: webhook_response_schema
    output: validated_draft_creation_result

  - id: step_notify_staff
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: validated_draft_creation_result
      recipient: support_staff
      message: A new AI-drafted response is ready for review in Gmail Drafts.
    output: notification_result

  - id: step_log_draft_creation
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: validated_draft_creation_result
      event: gmail_draft_created
      details:
        language: detected_language
        knowledge_bases_searched:
          - customerSupportDocs
          - clubDocuments
          - previousEmailResponses
    output: audit_log_entry

  - id: step_terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: success
      message: Gmail draft created successfully and staff notified
